findings.description: The KMS key protecting the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Because audit log data is long-lived and continuously appended, a large corpus of ciphertext remains bound to a single key version indefinitely, increasing the blast radius if that key material is ever compromised.
